evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Changing probe-training coverage across the stored format/template environments improves or does not improve held-out stated-purpose decoding on these frozen activations and checkpoints under exact row/block balance.
limitations: The same full320-v3 item bank was used in prior development analyses.
The two 70B equal-row outcomes were not inspected before this protocol freeze or pre-outcome amendment.
Benchmark and casual are confounded format/template environments with disjoint purpose-pair/template populations.
The checkpoints are fixed case studies, not a random model sample.
The primary family folds share payload blocks across train and test; a predeclared double-held-out payload robustness check addresses this without replacing the primary endpoint.
The endpoint is held-out stated-purpose probe performance, not behavior.
prohibited_claims: pure format effect independent of template/content
